# Planning & Task Workflow

## Before Starting Work
1. Create/reference a task or issue
2. Identify the appropriate branch type
3. Create branch from latest `main` (or `develop`)

## Task Breakdown
- Break large features into smaller, mergeable chunks
- Each branch should be focused and reviewable
- Aim for PRs that can be reviewed in < 30 minutes

## Documentation
- Update relevant docs with changes
- Add inline comments for complex logic
- Update README if API/usage changes

## Definition of Done
<!-- TODO: Define DoD checklist -->
- [ ] Code complete
- [ ] Tests written
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] PR approved
- [ ] Merged to target branch
